# TInterpreter pure virtuals implemented by hand in TCppInterOpInterpreter.cxx.
# Everything else gets a loud-failure override generated by gen_fatal.py.
#
# M3 scope: exactly what a P0 TH1D program calls, as measured by
# wasm/gates/rootlight/interp-probe. M4 adds the TFormula/TMethodCall surface.
Initialize
RegisterModule
ShutDown

# M4: what TFormula and TMethodCall call to compile and invoke a formula.
# (Only pure virtuals are listed here; gen_fatal.py generates overrides for
# those alone. The non-pure TInterpreter methods in the same path -- the
# ClassInfo_/CallFunc_ handle management -- are overridden by hand in the .cxx
# because ROOT's own base-class defaults for them are silent no-ops.)
Declare
ProcessLine
ProcessLineSynch
Calc
ClassInfo_Factory
CallFunc_SetFuncProto
CheckClassInfo
